checks.scope: Protocol alternatives and host policy are two different subjects.
checks.observable: Exactly-one variant selection can be observed from branches and calls.
checks.consistency: Procedural slices in Rules collide with AP-19 and AP-25.
checks.exceptions: Single-phase alternatives and standing policy are legitimate but different cases.
checks.fix: Separate operations or branch one outcome; keep only invariants in Rules.
checks.expression: The compound Detect hides two different repairs.

entries.rationale: An observable smell is paired with a migration that recreates procedural Rules.

checks.scope: Technique associations in I/O are clearly delimited.
checks.observable: Links and producer/executor wording are directly inspectable.
checks.consistency: The Protocol Apply repair conflicts with AP-114.
checks.exceptions: Resource links are sound; the Apply exemption needs removal.
checks.fix: Keep relationships at supported binds and I/O about meaning/shape.
checks.expression: The example resource phrase also illustrates HOW, so examples should avoid conditional duties.

entries.rationale: Retain the I/O boundary but repair its recommended destination.

checks.scope: Comments/JSDoc, with licenses and non-expressible API contracts excepted.
checks.observable: Information loss on deletion is observable through the code and types.
checks.consistency: Its information test agrees with succinctness; a line limit is not necessary.
checks.exceptions: Necessary rationale can require more than one line.
checks.fix: Delete redundant narration while retaining every non-obvious operative fact.
checks.expression: Single why-line is more restrictive than the stated defect.

entries.rationale: A small exception/repair change preserves the useful redundancy test.

checks.scope: Prose adjacent to complete examples and Templates.
checks.observable: The detector requires that the paragraph only re-explain shown keys.
checks.consistency: Template and Rules ownership agree with resource citation principles.
checks.exceptions: Additional constraints fall outside the only-restatement trigger.
checks.fix: Delete repeated explanation and cite the actual fill rules.
checks.expression: The field/timeout exemplar distinguishes duplication from new information.

entries.rationale: No necessary numerical density threshold: factual duplication is a usable qualitative test.

checks.scope: Reusable content carrying literal host or worktree roots.
checks.observable: A checkout-specific path can be compared with declared placeholders.
checks.consistency: Portability agrees with AP-61 and AP-127.
checks.exceptions: Resolved paths in planning evidence are explicitly protected.
checks.fix: Replace only the machine root with the applicable supplied placeholder.
checks.expression: Concrete bad example and portable alternatives make the criterion understandable.

entries.rationale: The scope separates portable instructions from session evidence.

checks.scope: Parallel install/build/start guidance already owned by setup.
checks.observable: Compare runbook steps with the setup home and unique deltas.
checks.consistency: Single ownership and retained workflow deltas are coherent.
checks.exceptions: Workflow-specific material and orientation links are protected.
checks.fix: Use the setup link and retain only additional requirements.
checks.expression: The clone/install/start exemplar identifies the repeated content.

entries.rationale: The rule detects copied operating instructions rather than all secondary documentation.

checks.observable: Sentence count and producer/gate/default restatements can be inspected.
checks.consistency: Meaning and compact shape agree with I/O contract separation.
checks.exceptions: Shape hints remain; value rosters move to structured values.
checks.fix: Keep the value definition and remove wiring tails.
checks.expression: One-line is best read as one concise definition, not rendered screen width.

entries.rationale: The structural tails provide an observable test beyond the qualitative word essay-length.

checks.scope: Operative literals across definitions require a reference-versus-constant distinction.
checks.observable: Declared-slot meaning is evidence, but does not decide comparison operands.
checks.consistency: Direct enum comparisons are required by AP-52/AP-112.
checks.fix: Replace copied bound values, not meaningful test constants.
checks.expression: Where a designator belongs assumes the question the detector must decide.

entries.rationale: A literal enum member can be correct operative syntax rather than duplicated state.
